# Remote monitoring startup BioIntelliSense raises $45 million in Series B funding
The company has developed two wearable sensors that are able to collect patient data outside the hospital.

[Global](https://www.mobihealthnews.com/enterprise-taxonomy-region/global)

By [Laura Lovett](https://www.mobihealthnews.com/author/laura-lovett),_Associate Editor_| August 3, 2021 | 3:57 PM

[Share to Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://www.mobihealthnews.com/news/remote-monitoring-startup-biointellisense-raises-45-million-series-b-funding&title=Remote%20monitoring%20startup%20BioIntelliSense%20raises%20$45%20million%20in%20Series%20B%20funding)[Share to X](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Remote%20monitoring%20startup%20BioIntelliSense%20raises%20$45%20million%20in%20Series%20B%20funding+https://www.mobihealthnews.com/news/remote-monitoring-startup-biointellisense-raises-45-million-series-b-funding)[Share to Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https://www.mobihealthnews.com/news/remote-monitoring-startup-biointellisense-raises-45-million-series-b-funding)

![piggy bank](https://www.mobihealthnews.com/sites/mhn/files/styles/wide/public/Piggy%2520bank%2520%2528Photo%2520by%2520Kwanchai%2520Lerttanapunyaporn%2520%253A%2520EyeEm%253AGetty%2520Images%2529_22.jpg.webp?itok=eySj3Oed)

Photo: Kwanchai Lerttanapunyaporn/Getty Images

Remote patient monitoring company BioIntelliSense scored $45 million in a Series B funding round. To date, the Colorado-based startup has raked in roughly $82 million.

**WHAT THEY DO**

The company has created two wearable products that let clinicians collect patient data outside the hospital.

The company says that the new cash will help it grow and expand globally.

Others in the space include [Huma](https://www.mobihealthnews.com/news/emea/british-health-tech-firm-huma-secures-130-million-series-c-round), which landed $130 million in Series C funding in May, [TytoCare](https://www.mobihealthnews.com/news/tytocare-raises-additional-50m-its-oversubscribed-series-d-round), which recently closed $50 million, [100plus](https://www.mobihealthnews.com/news/remote-patient-monitoring-company-100plus-scores-25m-seed-funding), which is backed by $25 million in seed funding, and [Biofourmis](https://www.mobihealthnews.com/news/softbank-leads-100m-investment-intelligent-health-monitoring-digital-therapeutics-startup), which closed $100 million in Series C funding.
